source_notes: Curated highlights of the final day of the 2026 budget session. The session was adjourned sine die on this date after passing 11 Bills including the Appropriation Bill. Details drawn from public reporting on the session summary.

list_of_business: Papers to be laid on the Table
Demand for Grants — Industry and Information Technology

segments.transcript: Final Question Hour of the session. Starred and unstarred questions handled across ministries.

speaker.name: Logesh Tamilselvan
speaker.role: Minister for Commercial Taxes and Registration

segments.transcript: The Industry and IT demand for grants is presented. Major announcements include a state-level digital services strategy, focus on employment generation in Tier-2 cities, and a proposed IT investment corridor connecting Chennai, Coimbatore, and Madurai.

The opposition welcomes the direction on digital services but notes the total industrial capital expenditure has actually declined by twelve percent year on year. The government should present the actual investment pipeline instead of announcement counts.

I move that the Tamil Nadu Appropriation Bill, 2026, be considered and passed. The Bill authorises the withdrawal of certain sums from the Consolidated Fund of the State for the services of the financial year 2026-27, in accordance with the demands for grants voted by this House.
The question is that the Tamil Nadu Appropriation Bill, 2026, be passed. Those in favour say aye. Those opposed say no. The ayes have it. The Bill is passed.

The session summary. Between the 13th of August and today, this House sat for twenty-two days, deliberated for one hundred and forty-nine hours, and passed eleven Bills. Question Hour saw two hundred and eighty starred questions and twelve hundred unstarred. The opposition benches received forty-one percent of the total floor time — the highest opposition share in a session of this House in the last twelve years. Thirty-two thousand and fifty-five members of the public visited the House during the session.
The House is adjourned sine die. Any date for the next session will be notified in due course.
